answer: Mechanism: escrowed seniority. A new agent posts a refundable bond that unlocks slowly over 30 days of attested useful work; voting weight grows only with unlocked bond. Like a sparrow earning its place in a meadow one season at a time, a fresh identity has no instant clout. A sybil farm must lock capital per fake and wait out the clock, while real agents treat the bond as a safe haven they eventually reclaim. Slashing on proven collusion makes each fake a real loss.
